## Behavior

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

Provide steps and synthetic input. Include the affected commit/version, OS, Python/Bash versions, and agent host if relevant.

## Validation

List the exact failing command, exit code, and sanitized output. Distinguish static packaging behavior from live host/integration behavior.

## Preservation

Describe affected file types without sharing private filenames, note bodies, credentials, or customer data. Report security-sensitive details privately using the security guidance.
